identity.name: 0N1 Force
identity.notes: Active anime/cyberpunk PFP project. A private commissioned reference VRM existed as a proof of concept, but contemporaneous development notes show collection-wide generation remained planned rather than shipped. A later 2024 ecosystem implementation proposal explicitly says 0N1 Force did not yet offer 3D models to its community, and the current official public assets surface remains a marketing/content-creation library rather than a 3D model delivery surface. The broad collection-wide avatar lane is therefore evidence-backed not_shipped while the private prototype is preserved separately.

evidence.note: Current official 0N1 Force link hub exposes the project Discord/community destinations.
Announcement identifies https://discord.gg/0n1-force as the official Discord.
DappRadar records 0N1 Force launch date as Aug 19, 2021.
Official project history independently states the collection minted in August 2021.

prototype_vrm.note: The historical avatar-development project had one commissioned reference avatar with Blend, VRM and Unitypackage outputs, with two more reference avatars planned. This proves a VRM prototype existed but does not establish a collection-wide release.

evidence.note: 0N1 Force is labeled VRM and 'Proof of concept only'; the entry says a commissioned reference avatar had Blend, VRM and Unitypackage files.

Development log says the goal was VR/VTuber-ready avatars for every NFT, the GitHub repo was currently private, there was one reference avatar and two more on the way, and trait/collection generation remained planned work.

storage.note: The documented reference-VRM development repository was private. No public collection-wide avatar storage or download location is evidenced. This storage fact describes the historical proof-of-concept lane, not a shipped 0N1 Force asset inventory.

evidence.note: The documented project GitHub repository github.com/madjin/0N1-avatars is explicitly marked 'currently private'.

vrm_inventory.note: A private single/reference VRM proof of concept existed, but the documented collection-wide program remained in reference-avatar and trait-production planning. A later 2024 ecosystem implementation proposal independently identifies 0N1 Force among collections that did not yet offer 3D models to their communities. The terminal state therefore applies to a collection-wide native VRM release, not to the existence of the private prototype.

evidence.note: Goal was avatars for every 0N1 Force NFT, but the log records one reference avatar, two more on the way, a private repo and substantial remaining trait-generation tasks.
0N1 Force is explicitly categorized as VRM, status 'Proof of concept only'.
2024 AIP-498 distinguishes collections already offering 3D models from collections that did not yet, explicitly naming 0N1 Force in the latter group.

avatar_inventory.note: This terminal state is intentionally broader than the VRM-specific finding. The known private commissioned reference avatar is retained as a prototype fact, but it was never a collection-wide holder/community delivery lane. Contemporary development records show collection generation unfinished, a 2024 implemented ecosystem proposal explicitly states 0N1 Force did not yet offer 3D models to its community, and the current official public assets page still presents marketing/content-creation assets rather than downloadable 3D avatar models. No later official collection-wide GLB, FBX, VRM or other usable 3D avatar release was recovered in this research pass.

evidence.note: Collection-wide VR/VTuber avatar generation was a goal, while the actual state was one private reference avatar, two more planned and substantial remaining trait-generation work.

AIP-498 explicitly distinguishes 0N1 Force from collections already offering 3D models and says 0N1 Force did not yet offer such models to its community. This statement is format-agnostic and therefore supports the broad avatar lane.
Current official assets page describes its public files as marketing assets for community content creation and exposes no collection-wide 3D avatar download lane.

file_access.note: No public collection-wide usable 3D avatar download/access flow shipped. The known reference-VRM development repository was private, and current official public assets are marketing/content-creation assets rather than an exhaustive avatar distribution surface.

evidence.note: Reference development repository was private and collection generation was unfinished.
Current official assets page presents public marketing assets for community content creation, not a collection-wide 3D avatar download inventory.

ip_rights.summary: Current 0N1 Force terms grant the NFT holder a worldwide royalty-free personal license and an unlimited worldwide commercial license to use the purchased art to create derivative works, while project/company rights and project-wide usage remain separately reserved by the issuer.

evidence.note: Terms revised Dec 3, 2023; sections ii-iii define personal and unlimited commercial/derivative holder usage.

project_status.note: Current official website/link hub and active project surfaces remain live; no sunset announcement was found in the current official sources checked.
